parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 reduced val_bpb from 1.075655 to 1.044714. Capacity scaling seems very effective. Next, I'll try increasing the learning rate to 0.1 to see if the increased capacity can handle more aggressive training.
parsed.description: Increase DEPTH to 6 and increase MATRIX_LR to 0.1 to test if higher capacity allows for more aggressive learning rates.
